question: In the carbide slag-assisted steam gasification of sewage sludge, what N2 flow rate, steam flow rate and isothermal reaction time were used in each run?
expect: N2 800 mL/min, steam 1.0 g/min, 30 min isothermal (sec. 2.2)
trap: the 105 °C / 24 h drying, or 3.0 kg H2O per kg SS
rendered: According to page 3 of the document, the N2 flow rate was maintained at 800 mL min^− 1, the steam flow rate was 1.0 g min^− 1, and the isothermal reaction time was 30 min.
